name: read_file
description: Reads a file by path and returns its text. Use offset and limit to paginate large files: the result reports the file's total byte size and, when truncated, the next_offset to resume from. Prefer this over search_code when you need a file's exact contents (e.g. src/agent/loop.zig, AGENTS.md, manifests).

path.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the sandbox root (e.g. "src/agent/loop.zig").

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from (0-based). Use the previous result's next_offset to continue a truncated read.

limit.description: Maximum number of bytes to return in this call.
